scope: Definitive native subscription errors, heterogeneous wildcard policy, optional active-speaker shape and explicit no-emission policy.

results.name: core-selector-final
results.phase: Core wildcard checks ran under patch152; Core sources are unchanged by parser-only patch153.

implementation: The private fixed-schema interpreter enforces additionalProperties:false only on closed objects; normal extension retention remains unchanged.

Retained failed native subscription operations now emit a correlated numeric error instead of ACK for unknown sources and incompatible capability failures. Closed server/HTTP and SDK numeric mappings preserve sanitized diagnostics.

Pure Core/native planning resolves source availability and codec compatibility before IO. Protected ordinary Session preflight checks current source presence/epoch, accepted kinds and current recipient/source scope before a native attempt.

An explicit ParticipantAll selection preserves the receiver-compatible future set and defers only typed Unsupported source kinds. It must acquire at least one current compatible authorized lease, never skips Authority, and reauthorizes every actual future source. Explicit kinds remain exact.

The optional Session speaker contract no longer requires connid and requires active_participant as an identifier or explicit null. Rust serialization retains null; actual Envelope golden and SDK signed wire cases exercise active/silence without changing command semantics. The stock profile emits no hints.
The runtime regressions include valid independently owned human, AI and observer handoff preparation staying muted and closed under the stricter parser.

The schema generator now implements --check without rewriting files. Isolated copies verify all three outputs reject drift and preserve content/mtime; the generated current contract passes225 vectors.

clause_evidence.u6-req-0125: Public signed production subscriptions now terminate successful routing with ACK, unknown source/Participant with correlated404 and incompatible explicit kind or disjoint negotiated data formats with488. Both failures precede effects, retain failed operations visible through HTTP, replay immutable observations with fresh wire correlation, and cannot partially install a mixed list. Both signatures route actual audio for an audio/video receiver selecting an audio-only Participant. Existing actual later-camera publication/removal/recovery, exact selectors and real data regressions preserve current/future selection behavior.
clause_evidence.u6-req-0128: The actual embedded Envelope schema and Rust typed serialization accept a Session-scoped active-speaker hint without connid, preserve a required explicit null for silence, and refuse missing/numeric active_participant or missing Session scope. Golden vectors retain stable IDs. The public SDK consumes actual independently signed controlled QUIC active/silence frames without confusing them with the correlated RPC ACK.
clause_evidence.u6-req-0129: The installed default server explicitly chooses the source-permitted no-emission policy. Documentation/reference distinguish optional advisory hints and null silence from durable state/role/mute/routing/authorization. No detector, cadence, or synthetic production emission is claimed; controlled SDK reception verifies preservation of active and null observations in both reader modes.

corrected_during_verification: Current embedded golden vectors exposed a missing additionalProperties:false branch in the fixed Rust validator. The parser now refuses asserted preparation readiness and other unknown closed metadata while retaining normal UCTP extensions. All current golden vectors and the dedicated closed/open metadata test are rerun.

Restored the three original Session invitation null/duplicate/capacity vector IDs missing from the generator output. The embedded225-vector kit now retains every original213-vector ID. Patch154 changes golden test data only, with all production source bytes and mtimes preserved.

The first Core run refused the synthetic wildcard fixture because its two publishers reused one logical audio Stream ID. Distinct fixture source IDs preserve the real unique catalog invariant; the final188-method staged-stream suite passes. The failing exploratory log remains private diagnostic evidence.
limits: Isolated local macOS arm64 production signed native QUIC. Heterogeneous source capability and definitive 404/488 replay exercise EdDSA and ES256; disjoint JSON/Text data formats exercise EdDSA. Broader regressions retain their declared local profiles.
Actual decoded audio and bounded silence probes establish routing behavior, not frozen performance, render quality, Linux/browser/remote/provider qualification or remote consumption.

Store and synthetic Core fixtures establish protected metadata/control behavior, not physical media. Optional active-speaker SDK traffic is a controlled independently signed post-auth QUIC fixture, in ordinary and owned-reader modes; the default production server installs no active-speaker detector or emitter.

Wildcard intent requires at least one compatible currently authorized kind. Only typed unsupported source kinds may be deferred; fresh actual publication and forwarding retain their own current authority. This adds no media grant or source capability. Private/handoff compositions retain their established protected policy rather than substituting ordinary-Session diagnostic rows.

The remaining12 clauses, full multiparty and private/transfer/kick/replace/crash/provider compositions, named hosting/remote profiles, G6-046 completion, acceptance, publication and the all105-task objective remain open.
